paper_title: Less, but Better Efficient Multilingual Expansion for LLMs via   Layer-wise Mixture-of-Experts
caption: The similarity of HSAs in different languages across all layers within Qwen1.5-1.8B.

model_annotations.Bulgarian:
This line chart illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Activations (HSAs) across four language pairs—en&en, en&es, en&el, and en&bn—as a function of layer number within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model. The vertical axis, labeled “Similarity,” is scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45, with major gridlines and tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The horizontal axis, labeled “Layer,” is also linearly scaled, ranging from 0 to 22, with labeled tick marks at integer intervals.

The red line, representing en&en, begins at approximately 0.07 at layer 0, rises to a peak of approximately 0.26 at layer 6, then declines to a low of approximately 0.08 at layer 22, before sharply increasing to approximately 0.44 at the final point (layer 22). The blue line, representing en&es, starts near 0.05, rises to approximately 0.25 at layer 6, then decreases to a low of approximately 0.04 at layer 20, before rising to approximately 0.27 at layer 22. The green line, representing en&el, begins near 0.04, peaks at approximately 0.15 at layer 6, and then gradually declines to approximately 0.04 at layer 22. The pink line, representing en&bn, starts near 0.04, rises to approximately 0.15 at layer 6, dips to a minimum of approximately 0.05 at layer 8, then increases to approximately 0.30 at layer 22. All lines are connected by solid lines with no markers.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line chart displays the similarity of HSAs (Hidden State Activations) across different languages within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, plotted against the layer number. The y-axis, labeled "Similarity," ranges from 0.00 to 0.45 with a linear scale and numerical tick marks at intervals of 0.05. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 22 with integer tick marks. Four distinct lines represent different language pairs: the red solid line for "en&en", the blue solid line for "en&es", the green solid line for "en&el", and the pink solid line for "en&bn". At layer 0, all lines start near 0.05, with the red line slightly higher. The red line ("en&en") rises sharply to a peak of approximately 0.26 at layer 6, then declines to around 0.15 by layer 12, dips further to about 0.08 by layer 20, and then rises steeply to approximately 0.44 at layer 22. The blue line ("en&es") follows a similar trend, peaking at approximately 0.25 at layer 6 and ending near 0.27 at layer 22. The green line ("en&el") peaks at approximately 0.15 at layer 6 and ends near 0.30 at layer 22. The pink line ("en&bn") peaks at approximately 0.14 at layer 6 and ends near 0.30 at layer 22.
model_annotations.English: This line plot illustrates the similarity of Hidden State Activations (HSAs) across different language pairs within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, plotted against the layer number. The x-axis represents “Layer,” ranging from 0 to 22 in integer increments, indicating the depth of the model’s architecture. The y-axis represents “Similarity,” scaled linearly from 0.00 to 0.45, indicating the degree of semantic or structural overlap between the HSAs of the specified language pairs. Four distinct lines represent the similarity between different language pairs: the red solid line for “en&en” (English-English), the blue solid line for “en&es” (English-Spanish), the green solid line for “en&el” (English-Greek), and the pink solid line for “en&bn” (English-Bengali). All lines begin near a similarity of 0.05 at layer 0, with the red line rising sharply to a peak of approximately 0.26 at layer 6 before declining and stabilizing around 0.15–0.18 through layers 8–12. The lines then exhibit a general downward trend through layers 14–20, with all four lines dropping to a minimum near 0.04–0.05 around layer 20. From layer 22 onward, all lines experience a steep upward trend, with the red line reaching a final value of approximately 0.44, the pink line reaching approximately 0.30, and the blue and green lines reaching approximately 0.27 and 0.30, respectively.
